comment: In the installed 2.1 build the eleven alteration buttons set their note only on the sample the trigger fires, because the assignment sits inside the Schmitt trigger's if block; the lamp toggles and holds. The maker's later source moves the assignment out of the if block so the alteration holds. The lines describe the alteration each control makes, with a Note line about the one-sample behaviour.
